scopes.proof: Actual Color channels are integers0..255. If max-min<=254, variance255 makes every scheme component3 and matches black. Otherwise channels are a permutation of(255,k,0). For k<=127 choose variance k+1 and the corresponding primary palette color(255,0,0); both have scheme(1,3,3). For k>=128 choose variance256-k and the corresponding secondary palette color(255,255,0); both have scheme(2,2,3). All permutations occur in the fixed Word palette. All candidate errors are<=765<65535, so a match always assigns best and returns inside the loop. Alpha does not change the three byte getters. The final fallback return is unreachable for actual immutable Color objects.

scopes.proof: At each line-break iteration, impl_WriteRunText returns false only when begin>=index; begin starts0 and is advanced only to an already processed control delimiter index+1. Thus empty segment means current index0 or preceding iteration was a control. Initial previous equals the current line-break control; after each processed delimiter previous is its control code<32. If the preceding iteration was printable, begin<=index-1 and the helper returns true. Induction gives a true condition on every line-break iteration. Immutable primitive input and actual synchronous serializer ownership are required; arbitrary reentrant method replacement is outside this domain.
